episodes.name: Bank Robbery
episodes.overviewEn: Animal Man interrupts a bank robbery by Captain Cold to save a mouse that Captain Cold was about to step on.

episodes.name: Train
episodes.overviewEn: Animal Man races against time to beat a speeding train in order to get a cow off the train tracks at the same time a woman has been tied to the train tracks.

episodes.name: Beach
episodes.overviewEn: Black Manta invades the beach and Animal Man defeats him after he had knocked down a crab’s sand castle

episodes.name: Invasion
episodes.overviewEn: Darkseid and his Parademons invade Earth and Animal Man scolds a dog’s owner for tying his dog to a parking meter
